# Code snippets

Some useful commands for manipulating trees in R.

## Drop tips

To remove tips from a phylogenetic tree you can use the `ape` command `drop.tip`.

```{r drop, eval=FALSE}
#ape::drop.tip()
#ape::drop.fossil()
```

## Time scaling a tree in R

Note: this is not the most robust way to time scale a tree but it provide a quick and dirty alternative. 

```{r timescale, eval=FALSE}

```
